t: Site latex builders gloves are designed for robust general handling tasks across various trades. These durable work gloves are ideal for construction, landscaping, and automotive repair, offering reliable hand protection. The crinkle textured latex coating provides excellent grip in both wet and dry conditions, ensuring secure handling of materials and tools. A breathable seamless polycotton liner keeps hands cool and comfortable during extended use. Elasticated knitted cuffs effectively prevent dirt and debris from entering the gloves, maintaining cleanliness and comfort on site. These gloves offer good resistance to abrasion and tear, making them a practical choice for demanding work environments.
